warnings: '(ชั้นล่าง)' names the LOWER of two roof planes (a secondary/porch roof), not a floor level — see S-08 for the main/upper roof covering the full building. This is structural roof framing (marked members, grid refs), so per the op04 roof_plan-vs-plan rule it is extracted as pattern 'plan', not 'roof_plan'.

The printed roof outline (thin reference line) and grid-crossing X marks span the full building depth (1.00m north of A through 1.00m south of C, matching S-08's footprint), but the actual purlin/rafter framing (thick double lines with the 'จันทันเหล็ก'/'แปเหล็ก' leaders) is only drawn from row B southward to C' (1.00m south of C). Read as: this lower roof plane physically covers only the B-to-C' (porch) zone; the outline/X-marks north of B are a reference/alignment guide to the upper roof's grid, not framing belonging to this sheet. Rafters recorded B-to-C' only.

One purlin row falls between B and C with no printed grid position — inserted per note 4.2's '@ไม่เกิน 1.00ม.' (spacing not exceeding 1.00m) rule, since the B-C gap (1.80m) exceeds that limit. Its own line is not individually dimensioned; recorded via spacing_mm rather than a fabricated position.
